description: Session guard for /claude-code:agent-create. Substitute __AGENT_NAME__ (the kebab-case agent name) and __BUNDLE__ (the target bundle), then MERGE the 'hooks' object into .claude/settings.local.json without clobbering existing hooks. Both entries carry the marker 'rdl-agent-create-guard' in their command so teardown removes exactly what was added. The Stop hook keeps the turn alive until the agent is fully wired, the generated docs/manifests are drift-free (generate_bundles_doc.py --check and generate_manifests.py --check), and validate-plugins.sh passes; it exits 0 when stop_hook_active is true so it never infinite-loops. The PostToolUse hook adds a declarative note (not an imperative command) listing the remaining wiring steps after an agents/*/agent.md write.

hooks.command:
bash -c '# rdl-agent-create-guard
input=$(cat)
[ "$(printf %s "$input" | jq -r .stop_hook_active)" = true ] && exit 0
name="__AGENT_NAME__"; bundle="__BUNDLE__"; missing=""
[ -f "agents/$name/agent.md" ] || missing="$missing [author agents/$name/agent.md]"
grep -q "$name" "registry/bundles/$bundle.yaml" 2>/dev/null || missing="$missing [add $name to registry/bundles/$bundle.yaml agents:]"
[ -f "plugins/$bundle/agents/$name.md" ] || missing="$missing [run scripts/sync-plugins.sh $bundle]"
python3 scripts/generate_bundles_doc.py . --check >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing [run python3 scripts/generate_bundles_doc.py . to refresh docs/bundles.md]"
python3 scripts/generate_manifests.py . --check >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing [run python3 scripts/generate_manifests.py . to refresh the manifests]"
grep -rq "$name" .changes/unreleased/ 2>/dev/null || missing="$missing [add a changie fragment naming $name]"
bash scripts/validate-plugins.sh >"/tmp/agent-create-$name.log" 2>&1 || missing="$missing [fix scripts/validate-plugins.sh: see /tmp/agent-create-$name.log]"
[ -n "$missing" ] && jq -nc --arg r "Pipeline incomplete for $name.$missing Complete these, then stop." "{decision:\"block\",reason:\$r}"
exit 0'

bash -c '# rdl-agent-create-guard
input=$(cat)
path=$(printf %s "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty")
case "$path" in
  */agents/*/agent.md|agents/*/agent.md)
    jq -nc "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\"Adding an agent to this catalog involves five wiring steps beyond the agent.md file: (1) list the agent name in registry/bundles/__BUNDLE__.yaml under agents:, (2) run scripts/sync-plugins.sh __BUNDLE__ to copy it into plugins/__BUNDLE__/agents/, (3) run python3 scripts/generate_bundles_doc.py . and python3 scripts/generate_manifests.py . to refresh the generated docs and manifests, (4) add a changie fragment, (5) run scripts/validate-plugins.sh until it exits 0. Those remaining steps are what make the change CI-green.\"}}"
    ;;
esac
exit 0'
